p99_aggregation: Nearest-rank P99 over successful requests within each QPS/repeat wave, then arithmetic mean of the two repeat-level P99 values.
cumulative_latency_aggregation: Per-request cumulative provisioning latency is the sum of worker wait-for-ready times. Average across requests within each repeat wave, then arithmetic mean across repeats.
resource_aggregation: Use peak CPU cores and peak memory GiB recorded for each wave, then arithmetic mean across repeats.
configuration_notes: Retained runs contain only on_demand, laplace, and always_on modes.
Laplace has prompt prewarm and predictive warmer enabled together; it maps to the requested +Prefetch stage, but cannot isolate +Prewarm.
No semantic cache or out-of-band data transmission E2E mode is present in retained runs.
The two measured modes use the same sampled trace IDs per QPS/repeat and default model parameters; the runner derives a different deterministic API seed per mode.
The retained run contains two repeats per QPS, not the requested ten.

prefetch_observation.scope: Retained successful Laplace-mode sessions only; prompt/stream C1 warmups excluded from SDG metrics.
prefetch_observation.resource_accounting: No SDG predictive warmups were scheduled in retained successful runs, so SDG-attributable discard count and resource integrals are zero for these logs. Per-warmup CPU and memory were not recorded; host wave samples cannot attribute resources to an individual warmup. Intent-aware prompt/stream C1 warmups are a separate mechanism and are excluded.
prefetch_observation.denominator_definition: Candidate-target denominator is the sum of candidate_count over predictive calls. The retained logs emit zero candidates, so hit rate has a zero denominator. False-positive denominator is accepted predictive-stage prewarm_schedule events; zero were recorded.
